title: Documents
description: Registrations, inspections and taxes with their expiry

help.title: About vehicle documents
help.overview: Keep each car's papers here, with scans. A car is not handed over while its registration, inspection, emissions test or road tax runs out before the return.

sections.title: On this page
items: Use Renew in the menu: the new record is filled from the old one and linked to it, so the history stays a chain.
Staff are warned 30 days before an expiry, and again on the day one lapses with no renewal.
Documents without an expiry date never trigger a reminder.
